headline: Last session: Sensex crossed 81,000 and Nifty settled above 25,000 as markets remain closed today for Diwali-Balipratipada

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: Indian stock exchanges (BSE and NSE) are closed today, November 10, on account of Diwali-Balipratipada.
In the last session, Sensex and Nifty extended gains to close at their highest levels in over eight months.
Modest market gains in the previous trading session were supported by oil price corrections and strong banking performance.
Trading on both exchanges will resume on Wednesday, November 11.
whatHappening: NSE and BSE are shut today for a market holiday and will reopen for normal trading tomorrow.
Blackstone is set to become a key investor in IIFL Finance by acquiring a 15% stake.
In the previous trading day, Sensex closed 107 points higher above 81,000 while Nifty closed above 25,000.
Shares of Data Patterns rallied 9% during the last trading session.
summary:
Indian stock markets are closed today, November 10, due to the Diwali-Balipratipada trading holiday.
In the previous session, Sensex surpassed 81,000 and Nifty closed above 25,000, reaching eight-month highs.
Key developments include Blackstone acquiring a 15% stake in IIFL Finance and Data Patterns surging 9% in the last session.
